title: Support of a finite type quasi-coherent module and of its pullback
statement: Let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent] on a scheme $X$, with support $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. (1) $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ is closed in $X$. (2) For $x\in X$: $x\in\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\iff\mathcal F_x\ne0\iff\mathcal F_x\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}\kappa(x)\ne0$. (3) For every morphism of schemes $f:Y\to X$ the pullback $f^*\mathcal F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is of finite type and $\operatorname{Supp}(f^*\mathcal F)=f^{-1}(\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal F)$.
